info.name: Yext Admin Account Settings Suggestions API

params.name: listingId
params.description: The unique identifier of a listing on your site is known as the listingId.

items.docs: Yext uses Suggestions: List to retrieve all active suggestions data for business owners. You should provide access to all suggestions in status “PENDING”.

params.name: suggestionId
params.description: The unique identifier of a suggestion on your site is known as the suggestionId.

items.docs: Yext uses Suggestions: Get to retrieve the suggestion object for a specific suggestion ID.

params.name: suggestionId
params.description: The unique identifier of a suggestion on your site is known as the suggestionId.

items.docs: Yext uses Accept/Reject to indicate whether a suggestion object has been accepted or rejected by the user.
